resolution: Completed a read-only active cart/editor audit of the hot-state persistence blast radius before color changes. Confirmed the AppFrame whole-state effect is the root infestation: all 217 AppFrame setState sites trigger persistState, including searches, rename-as-you-type fields, model-tool mirroring, status/UI toggles, and each distinct face touched by Paint Faces. Identified two narrower sibling mirrors: ModelView writes its ToolTwig on every tool/brush change while also mirroring the same snapshot through AppFrame, and WorldViewport writes camera pose on every 16ms pan/orbit/pointer sample. Distinguished properly bounded paths: debounced world/globals saves, MapPaintDock local slider drafts with commit, and outliner/map dialog rename drafts. No source files changed.
